verdict.rationale: Twenty documents adding custom fields (20+ field types) and building views with AND/OR filters, multi-field sorting, grouping and saved custom views across table, kanban and calendar layouts, so the core of the story is covered by first-party docs. The evidence does not show that saved views can be shared with teammates, or that a non-admin ops user can add fields without admin involvement. missing for 10: evidence that views are shared across the team, evidence that non-admin users can add fields and views themselves, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project

citations.quote: add custom fields with 20+ field types
Filter with AND/OR logic, sort by multiple fields, group records, and save custom views.
Custom objects get the same first-class treatment as built-in ones — including API endpoints, views, permissions, and workflow triggers.
